We just returned from an amazing trip to Ladakh and thanks to yak travels. Our driver Mr Acho Thakur is a great driver and guide for our 5 nights and 6 days trip. Mr Thakur's behaviour is very humble and polite besides being an expert driver through the tough roads of our trip.  we are comfortable and when travelling with friends a dependable person like him is very important for us.

Yak Travel is a great agency if you want to explore Ladakh. There, you'll always find people to travel with and share the cost of taxis. The drivers are also very careful and drive safely.

We went to Tso Moriri and Hanle, which were incredible! We also did a 4-day trek in the Markha Valley, which is totally doable even if you don’t have much experience.

The manager of the agency is super nice and will always give you good advices !!

Honest and very helpful people with YAK agency. Prices are fair, did some comparisons. Guide Rigzin is very kind, sincere and knowledgeable. You will get the best homestays during your treks as well. Did Marka Valley trek, it was amazing. I highly recommend.

Mr. Nawang from yak travel was very helpful and professional. I would always recommend yak travel to my friends and family. Mr. Stanzin Korban Saboo (our cab driver) was amazing. He was very polite and helpful. Thank you Yak Travel for your services.

Had a great experience with Yak Travel Agency in Leh. We hired a taxi for a few days and everything was super smooth — right from trip planning to getting all the required permits for border areas. Highly recommend if you're looking for a stress-free, well-managed trip in Ladakh.
It was a great experience with yak travels you can undoubtedly take travel related facilities from here.
